home.title: An apartment in Oman. With numbers, without promises.
home.lead: Prices, locations, how buying works. We say where each number comes from, and we call estimates estimates.

q1.h: How much does an apartment in Oman cost?
q1.p: Price depends on location, construction stage and layout. For each project we show a from-price and the date it applies to.

q2.h: What to watch for with off-plan?
q2.p: Buying before completion has its own specifics: payment plan, handover date, the developer's standing. We go through them plainly.

q3.h: Gross yield is not what lands in your account.
q3.p: A gross yield estimate leaves out management fees, vacant periods and taxes. That is why a yield here is always a developer estimate, with a source and a date.

s1.p: The AI assistant answers general questions about Oman and the projects. It is an AI, not an adviser, and says so up front.

s2.p: From-price, construction stage, units and the developer's estimate in one place.

s3.p: Send an enquiry. A person gets back to you, not a machine.

home.honestP: We sell property, not investments. So three rules apply.
honest: Every number has a source or an “estimate” label.
We never promise or guarantee a return.
Tax, legal and financing decisions belong to your independent adviser.

sections.p: Data from the enquiry form (name, email, phone, message) and, with your consent, a transcript of your conversation with the AI assistant.
We handle enquiries and keep them for at most 24 months. Stored conversations without an enquiry are deleted after 90 days.
Hosting (Vercel), database (Supabase, EU), AI model (Anthropic), email (Resend).
You may request access, correction, erasure or portability and withdraw consent. Delete a stored conversation with the button in the chat; exercise other rights by email.
